definitions.gloss: early morning; toward morning; the small hours before dawn
definitions.explanation: Refers to the time period in the very early morning, typically between about 3 AM and sunrise. Often used when describing events that happen in the late night transitioning into morning.

examples.japanese: {朝方|あさがた}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{起|お}きていた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I was up until early morning.

examples.japanese: {朝方|あさがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped suddenly in the early morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝方|あさがた}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}し{込|こ}んで→話し込む：20658_hanashikomu⟧しまい、⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{辛|つら}かった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: Yesterday I ended up talking with friends until early morning, and the lack of sleep made the whole day tough.

notes:
Refers to the period of very early morning, roughly from around 3 AM to sunrise. It emphasizes the transitional time from night to morning, rather than the morning after waking up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝方|あさがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the early morning
- {朝方|あさがた}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until early morning
- {朝方|あさがた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from early morning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝型|あさがた}→朝型：16867_asagata⟧: morning person — a lifestyle type, not a time of day (same reading but different kanji)
- ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧: early morning — more formal, used in news and official contexts
- ⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧: dawn, daybreak — more specifically the time just as the sky starts to brighten
- ⟦{未明|みめい}→未明：27573_mimei⟧: before dawn — formal/news usage, typically for events occurring in the predawn hours
